title: Class 1 'tetra' objects fly in formations of three to twenty

tellings.quote: Yes, the objects of the first class usually They fly in groups.

plain: Every story here was told on the podcast American Alchemy, hosted by Jesse Michels. According to James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, the objects his team calls "class 1" or "tetra" usually fly in groups, in formations of three to twenty, during the company's sky-watching operations between 2021 and 2025. Valor says he saw this himself, and he tells it to Michels as one of the regular patterns his team has logged, which would mean the objects come back in organized groups.
